account-locked: Akoonka si ku-meelgaar ah ayaa loo xannibay isku-dayo gelitaan oo fashilmay oo aad u badan awgood. Fadlan mar dambe isku day.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel waxaa loogu talagalay SuperAdmin oo keliya, domainka Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: WeKan oo ku jira Weddy, Cloud Panel wuxuu hal server uga adeegaa domains badan oo WeKan ah, mid kastaana xogtiisa gaarka ah ayuu leeyahay. Domainka Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin ayaa maamula domains-ka iyo CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Marka uu jiro furaha CloudFlare API, domain-ka aagiisu ku jiro koontadaada CloudFlare wuxuu helaa diiwaan DNS ah oo proxy ah iyo shahaadada CloudFlare Origin. Domains-ka kale waxay helaan shahaado Let's Encrypt. Furaha waxaa lagu kaydiyaa server-ka mar dambena lama muujiyo.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ma jiro furaha CloudFlare API oo la kaydiyay: domain kastaa wuxuu helaa shahaado Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Furaha CloudFlare API waa la kaydiyay.
error-ldap-login: Khalad ayaa dhacay markii la isku dayay gelitaanka LDAP
error-username-taken: Magacan isticmaalaha hore ayaa loo qaatay
last-modified-at: Markii ugu dambaysay ee la beddelay
